A beautiful work of art. Third Person Looter Shooter with tons of customization. Hundreds of weapons to choose from. Huge Roaster of Warframes to choose from. Companions? Kavats, Kubrows, Sentinels and Moas! "Breath-taking" open world design with on-the-fly mission selection option. Although the game starts the become lackluster when you have completed/own most of what the game offers, still there are quite some things that you can do that can help progress you or your clan in the game.

Pros:
-Great F2P system. NO LOOTBOXES :D
-Large and a very active community
-Helpful and Friendly Playerbase
-Great movement mechanics
-Great visual art and ambience
-Exceptional soundtracks (especially The sacrifice).
-Detailed story although the quests deliver it poorly

Cons:
-Lack of sustainable content
-H o s t M i g r a t i o n
-Does require you to invest extra time in the game to learn the In-Game Market place.
-Network related Issues are quite common hence sometimes you may be removed from the session without receiving your rewards
-Annoying continuous NPC monologues
-Super grindy. One of the most grindy games I've played till now
-Poorly balanced warframes
- Vauban
- Melee 3.0 (jk)

Considering I enjoy playing games on my own mostly, I actually enjoy playing with random groups in Warframe. The community is super nice. I don't think I have ever met an asshole in this game other than myself. I also like the pay model. It's free to play and not pay 2 win. It's more like "pay to get bored faster" but you can't "win" in this game.

Its buggy held together by tape and bubblegum in places, the devs often have ideas that go beyond their abilities and thus fall flat when they come out. However in spite of all that its still one of if not the best free to play game available with a unique setting and story (what little there is) and amazing if slightly dated art design and graphics. In what other F2P can you trade the premium currency with other players, or get the premium items without spending it? yeah its a grindy game full of RNG and spending too long on simple things, but its still the best one of its kind.

So yeah.. 77.9 hrs on record as of writing this review, 73.3 hrs in the last two weeks. More accurately, 73.3 hrs in the last 4 days.

This game, is so F2P, you will not be able to convince me to play another F2P game and call it balance. It is not P2W at all. I did spend a few bucks for platinums, on slots and cosmetics only. You might think that farming / repeating a single map is repetitive. But its not, every time you go in, its different, they use modular tile sets for their maps, /SPOILERS/ Puzzles have less variants that actually makes it easier to learn the patterns.

Aside from gameplay, the COMMUNITY, I repeat, the COMMUNITY is AMAZING. Make sure you join a clan, there are many helpful tips and tricks that I have learned and still learning from these amazing players, and also, the trading part? Some people highball the crap out of you, and some gives you spares for FREE. I have never experienced such treatment from players from other MMOs or other games in general. Shoutout to SpessMahreens and xXDediostaXx for helping me out through my still ongoing journey.

How about the devs? They listen to the community, planned properly and give what the community wants.

More review after hitting 100 hrs maybe?

Where to begin? Its such a sprawling mass of stuff to do by now..

Not because of the excellent quests and writing, nor the allure of new frames to try out.
No, what draws me in is the sheer joy of the gameplay. It is simply a lot of fun to play.

This game is awesome! The gameplay is the best of any game in this genre that i've ever played. Story is great, only a little sad that it starts really late. But if you like the gameplay enough, than the start of the story feels more like a reward for your efforts.

The community of the game i also great. Willing to help when you ask. You can also trade with other people to make platinum, wich is the premium currency of the game. So if you're not willing to spend any money yet, that is also an option for you.

A lot of cosmetics that are purchaseable through steam itself are made by players for other players. Those are called tennogen. So the game devs also apreciate art that is made of this game.

I've been playing this game for about 6 years now, and it's about time for me to move away. Those were good six years, with their downfalls and upbringings. I may not return to this game in the future, but I will never forget it. Thank you, Digital Extremes, for all your hard work on this game, and good luck to everyone who's playing or thinking of playing Warframe.

After hundreds of hours logged into this game, not only on PC but on Console as well, I have still so much left to do. The game constantly updates and adds new features to the game making it enjoyable for years to come. One of my top picks and favorite games on the steam market! I highly recommend to anyone who is looking for an action packed game that's free to play and one that doesn't shove in-game paid content down your throat.

P.S. You can get the paid for currency (platinum) by trading unwanted items/mods to other in-game players!

Don't do it. You're making a mistake.

Edit 9 years later: It got better. Less predatory monetization and more pay-for-convenience. Gameplay got better too.

The game gets more and more overlwhelming with every update.

As someone who has deeply hated almost every other grindy RPG game I have played the fact that I have 400 hours on this game should tell you that its incredibly enjoyable, grinding in this game isn't just clicking the same couple of buttons type garbage of most RPG games, its a combination of acrobatic movement, satisfying gunplay and gorgeous blend of abilities, classes and enemies. 

Its also such a memorable aestethic experience, the style, the music, the lore, for a free to play game its actually incredible how much quality there is in this game both in terms of gameplay, story and graphics. 

A big issue however is just how much content there is, even as a returning player I find myself overwhelmed every time I try to dip my feet back in to this game, browsing the wiki for hours IS necessary and I think the developers have somewhat compromised themselves by adding new features which are distinct from previous features, as opposed to adding new features which are built upon the old features.

Nevertheless I think the game keeps getting better and there is room for this issue to be solved.

I am mostly finally writing a review for this to try and offset the bomb of negative reviews after the latest update because yes, it did annoy me that I finaly got kuva zarr like 2 weeks before the nerf and I miss the op power, but I also play solo most of the time so the few times I played with other people I obviously didn't use it because I hate being the one that just stands there... The only case for me where I can run over other players easily is using the secondary Laetum but that is late game and once again I don't use it too often when playing with others!

I enjoyed the change mostly because now I feel motivated to do other builds and play around more, the new free frame is amazing as well with great synergy between abilities!

Free to play all the way.
You can get everything you need from the game itself without spending any real money on it.

If you are picky and want this or that colour on your warframe/weapon, or if you have a save everything mania (such as saving all different warframes and all weapons e.t.c.) then yes you ned to cough up a bit of money.

Hey, you get resources easily with some grinding (depending on your level of tolerance, grinding is not so bad) and you get blueprints easily by killing boses - you can afford to sell the weapons and warframes to make room for more without feeling too much of a loss.

Yes, totally free and fun game.
Repetitive only if you play solo or claim to play with others yet run away from them all the time - yeah, you need to learn teamplay, so if u aren't one then get lost right now. ^^

If you get caught up with the dopamine milking that is the gameplay loop it can be very fun but I recommend that those who are prone to developing behavioral addictions such as people with ADHD stay away from the game. No matter what people say about the f2p model of warframe it does very much use predatory practices and tricks to push you into spending money.

Yes I know every live service game works like that, that doesn't make it okay.

One of the best free game to ever exist. Can form clans. Can pilot ships. Has open world. Supports PvP and PvE. Constant free updates and expansions. Extensive trading system. You name it, the game has it. The game is free anyways. Go and try it out with your friends. You wont regret it. Needs about 2hrs to get through the initial tutorials and grind. Then you are free to dominate the universe.

Buy if you like to Grind your teeth?

No but seriously, If you are a grinder of any sort, then this is the Grind for you.

Like the Grind here is insane BUT intense. Think Destiny Grind but better (I'm sure everyone that looks at this review has heard or played Destiny).

Pay2Win? Nope not really. Pay2lookgoodorgetstuffquickercauseyoudontfeellikegrinding then yes, but even then EVERYTHING can be attained simply by....you guessed it....grinding. It is actually a very interesting model I have to say. Appeals to the wider masses which is why this game is still one of the more highly played games on Steam (always on the top 10 I think on Steamcharts).

There is depth to the 'builds' I guess and potential to speed run, join a clan and do other stuff but ultimately you will be Grinding. But hey, it is pretty fun for a grind :D and that's why I reccomend it 100%.

Graphics: Great- very good detail especially for being a free game 10/10
Gameplay: Well done-gameplay can get a bit repetative, but if you like to farm or come from games heavy in farming this is right up your alley 9.5/10
Controls: Simple- yes this game can be a bit overwhelming at first but the controls are there for a reason. This game is extremely parkor oriented at times. So if you like pretending to be a ninja that is also a plus. 9/10
Character designs: Unique- some characters pull from mythology, but they are all unique in their own way to support each other on the battlefield. 9/10
Overall: 8/8 m8
